source: Trek route log, 24 September to 28 November 2019
editorialPolicy: Public factual route notes. Exact dates, route conditions, places, distances and music remain; first-person reflection and personal, health, relationship, financial, accommodation and identifying third-party details are omitted.

1.label: farmland east of Paris
1.text: The route left Paris through farmland and forest.

2.label: green river path
2.text: A quiet path followed a clear green river through fields.

3.label: river path
3.text: The route followed the river for about twenty kilometres before Château-Thierry.

3.label: château-thierry
3.text: The route passed through Château-Thierry and continued on wooded paths.

4.label: overnight rain
4.text: Heavy rain arrived overnight before the route resumed in daylight.

6.label: running section
6.text: A two-kilometre running section marked the return to the route after a rest.

7.label: canal and vineyards
7.text: The route left Châlons-en-Champagne along a canal between vineyards and orchards in hot sun.

8.label: thunderstorm
8.text: A major thunderstorm brought heavy rain and lightning on the route into Bar-le-Duc.

9.label: still woodland
9.text: Still conditions and sunlight appeared through the woods.

11.label: towards nancy
11.text: The route to Nancy crossed a national park in persistent rain beneath tall trees.

13.label: courtyard music
13.text: Live music was playing in a courtyard along the route.

13.label: canal section
13.text: The route continued along the canal, alternating walking and running.

14.label: cliff path
14.text: Cliff faces flanked the path, with blue flies moving between them; Witchi Tai To played during this section.

15.label: saverne to the rhine
15.text: The canal route left Saverne toward the Rhine and the German border.

16.label: german border
16.text: The route reached the German border fifteen days after Paris.

22.label: towards munich
22.text: Nine consecutive route days ended with a faster final section toward Munich after dark.

25.label: munich rest
25.text: Two days off route preceded the Austrian section.

25.label: austria approach
25.text: A long mixed walking and running day covered about sixty kilometres toward the Austrian mountains.

26.label: short of austria
26.text: The day ended about twenty kilometres before Austria.

27.label: entering austria
27.text: Austria began with a sharp climb and a small waterfall, with mountains surrounding the road.

28.label: towards ankogel
28.text: A cold, crisp morning became bright sun as the route rose toward the Ankogel mountains.

29.label: mountain paths
29.text: Steep mountain paths opened views across Austria, with a large bird circling through the valley below.

30.label: the tauern
30.text: Streams, scrambles and narrow ridges crossed the Tauern at about 2,500 metres before descending empty ski slopes after dark.

31.label: sunny long section
31.text: Bright sun continued into late October during another route section of about fifty kilometres.

32.label: trail section
32.text: The day covered about forty kilometres of trails.

34.label: quiet roads
34.text: The route passed goats on roofs, scarecrows and quiet roads.

36.label: fog and wooded climb
36.text: More than fifty kilometres through drizzle, wind chill, waterlogged paths and fog ended with a steep wooded climb after dark.

37.label: slovenia to ptuj
37.text: Another fifty kilometres in rain and low temperatures completed the brief Slovenian section at Ptuj.

38.label: entering croatia
38.text: Croatia began on a busy main road before the route moved onto a quiet canal path.

40.label: rest day
40.text: After fifteen consecutive route days, this date became a rest day before the route resumed.

40.label: towards osijek
40.text: Grey roads and flat trails continued east across Croatia toward Osijek.

41.label: croatian plain
41.text: A warm, sunny day crossed the sparse northern Croatian plain.

42.label: farms to osijek
42.text: Trains bridged unsafe main-road sections before about forty kilometres of flat farmland to Osijek.

47.label: half-marathon section
47.text: A half-marathon running section ended beside a Croatian road marked with a mine warning.

48.label: entering serbia
48.text: Muddy Croatian fields led to passport control, followed by river paths, fishermen and small huts on the Serbian side under a dark grey sky.

49.label: to novi sad
49.text: The seventy-kilometre route to Novi Sad continued onto technical paths and through bushes after dark.

52.label: mud before sunset
52.text: The final five kilometres crossed muddy, uneven ground after dark.

53.label: belgrade
53.text: A long, straightforward route reached Belgrade in clear weather.

56.label: leaving belgrade
56.text: An early start from Belgrade crossed brambles, a small mountain and later darkness.

57.label: farm tracks
57.text: The route followed farm tracks used by small tractors.

58.label: pipeline route
58.text: Pipeline construction created an unexpectedly direct section of route.

59.label: stray dog
59.text: A stray dog followed part of the short route section.

65.label: entering bulgaria
65.text: The route crossed into Bulgaria with Sofia one day away.

66.label: sofia
66.text: The route reached Sofia, completing the Paris-to-Sofia trek.
